about: Complete exchanges for the sphinx dialogue on levels/sphinx.json. name, precondition and why are documentation; request, status and response are the HTTP exchange. Each scenario starts from a freshly started server and is independent of the others.

placeholders.session_id: example-server-session stands for the random id created at server start.
placeholders.interaction ids: example-interaction-N stands for a random id; N restarts at 1 in each scenario.
placeholders.answer of 501 characters: The 501 x are written as <501 x> in the request body.

scenarios.name: accepted-answer
scenarios.summary: A correct answer opens the exit and wins the game.

steps.name: initial state
steps.why: revision 0: nothing has happened yet.

steps.name: encounter
steps.precondition: After three east actions the player is at (4, 1), turn 3, revision 3.

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: The attempted move costs turn 4. The dialogue appearing is a visible change: revision 4. The player stays at (4, 1).

steps.name: submit the answer

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: 202 means the evaluation started, not that the answer is right. No turn is used; pending is visible: revision 5.

steps.name: read while pending
steps.precondition: The evaluator has not replied yet.

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: A read changes nothing: same turn, same revision.

steps.name: read the verdict
steps.why: The verdict is published once: revision 6, turn still 4. The player is on the exit, the dialogue is closed and the game is won.

steps.name: answer after the victory
steps.precondition: The dialogue was closed by the accepted answer.

error.message: This dialogue is no longer active

steps.why: No interaction is active any more: the request is refused and nothing changes.

scenarios.name: rejected-then-retry
scenarios.summary: Two wrong answers give two hints; the third answer wins.

steps.name: encounter

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Turn 4, revision 4.

steps.name: submit a wrong answer

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Pending: revision 5.

steps.name: read the refusal
steps.precondition: The evaluator returned correct=false with a hint.

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Revision 6. The passage stays closed; the hint is the interaction message and the question is unchanged.

steps.name: try to move during the dialogue

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Moves and wait are paused during a dialogue: 200 with the same state, no turn, no revision.

steps.name: submit a second wrong answer

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Same interaction id, new private attempt: revision 7.

steps.name: read the second refusal
steps.precondition: The evaluator used the history and returned a different hint.

interaction.message: Your voice comes back to you.
interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Revision 8, still turn 4.

steps.name: submit the right answer

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Revision 9.

steps.name: read the victory
steps.why: Revision 10, turn 4: three answers used no turn at all.

scenarios.name: failure-then-retry
scenarios.summary: The evaluator fails once; the same answer is accepted on retry.

steps.name: encounter

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Turn 4, revision 4.

steps.name: submit while the service is down
steps.precondition: Dialogue in status question; the evaluator will fail.

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: The POST still succeeds with 202: the failure is not known yet. Revision 5.

steps.name: read the failure
steps.precondition: The evaluator raised an error (timeout, service down or malformed reply).

interaction.message: The evaluator is unavailable. Try again.
interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: The failure is a dialogue status, not an HTTP error: revision 6, passage closed, fixed message, same question.

steps.name: retry the same answer
steps.precondition: Dialogue in status error; the service is back.

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Revision 7.

steps.name: read the victory
steps.why: Revision 8, turn 4.

scenarios.name: cancel-then-late-verdict
scenarios.summary: The player cancels while pending; the late verdict is ignored.

steps.name: encounter

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Turn 4, revision 4.

steps.name: submit the answer

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Revision 5.

steps.name: second answer while pending
steps.precondition: The first evaluation is still running.
steps.why: Only one evaluation at a time: refused, nothing changes.

steps.name: cancel
steps.why: The panel closes: revision 6, no turn. The passage stays closed and the running evaluation becomes obsolete.

steps.name: read after the late verdict
steps.precondition: The evaluator finally returned correct=true for the cancelled attempt.
steps.why: The late result is ignored: still revision 6, still playing at (4, 1), no dialogue.

steps.name: answer with the old id

error.message: This dialogue is no longer active

steps.why: The old interaction no longer exists.

steps.name: meet the sphinx again

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: A new attempt to enter costs turn 5: revision 7. New interaction id, same question.

scenarios.name: quit-while-pending
scenarios.summary: The player quits while pending; nothing can change afterwards.

steps.name: encounter

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Turn 4, revision 4.

steps.name: submit the answer

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Revision 5.

steps.name: quit while pending
steps.why: running becomes false and the dialogue is removed: revision 6, no turn.

steps.name: read after the late verdict
steps.precondition: The evaluator returned correct=true after quit.
steps.why: The server stays readable; the late result cannot reopen the game: still revision 6.

steps.name: answer after quit
steps.why: A valid request on a closed game is refused.

scenarios.name: refused-requests
scenarios.summary: Requests refused before any evaluation starts.

steps.name: encounter

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: Turn 4, revision 4.

steps.name: wrong content type
steps.why: Checked first, before reading the body.

steps.name: unreadable JSON
steps.why: The body is not JSON.

steps.name: missing field
steps.why: Exactly interaction_id and answer are required.

steps.name: extra field
steps.why: Extra fields are refused: the browser cannot send its own verdict.

steps.name: non-string answer
steps.why: Both values must be strings.

steps.name: blank answer
steps.why: Length is checked after trimming: 0 characters.

steps.name: answer of 501 characters
steps.why: The limit is 500 characters after trimming.

steps.name: unknown interaction id

error.message: This dialogue is no longer active

steps.why: The shape is valid but the id is not the active interaction.

steps.name: cancel with unknown id

error.message: This dialogue is no longer active

steps.why: Same rule for cancel.

steps.name: read after the refusals

interaction.question: What repeats your words without a mouth?

steps.why: A refused request changes nothing and starts no evaluation: still revision 4, status question.
